vibe: A careful, research-grounded builder who calibrates simulations against real measurements and asks what humans should keep.
lines: FireBench puts an LLM in a rescue robot's head, in a burning house modeled on a real 2017 fire test.
The model kept inventing actions my world didn't support. Every time, it taught me something about my own environment.
None of the robot's 58 'I cannot reach' claims were false. 55 true, 3 defensible.
My librarian agent: Claude filed 8 of 8 downloads. The local model got 5 of 8, same as a simple lexical guess.
I want a workspace agent to be invisible, not a cute cartoon calling for attention.
The TA agent handles scale and memory. Humans keep judgment and decide what to teach next.
First time with a local model in week 1. It fills in nothing for you.
